name: Enticing Negolash
summary: Along the shores of Stranglethorn Vale rests an abandoned lifeboat marked with the faded words Smotts' Revenge. Piling barbecued buzzard wings and junglevine wine upon the wrecked craft serves to lure out the giant Negolash.

sections.title: A Tempting Offering
sections.body: The wreckage of a small boat lies neglected, carrying only weathered lettering that names it Smotts' Revenge. To catch the attention of Negolash during the hunt against him, the boat must be turned into bait, heaped with ten barbecued buzzard wings and five bottles of junglevine wine.

faq.answer: It is an abandoned, broken boat bearing the faded inscription Smotts' Revenge, used as a platform to arrange food and drink to lure Negolash.

faq.q: What provisions are required for the offering?
faq.answer: The offering requires ten barbecued buzzard wings alongside five vessels of junglevine wine, which are stacked together directly onto the wreck.

faq.q: When does this task become available?
aliases: when can i do enticing negolash
faq.answer: This offering can only be prepared while undertaking the hunt to face Negolash.
